thread:
maria: :rotating_light: paging: p99 tail latency spike on inference-gw observed at 03:00Z, streaming stalls reported. Dashboards show kv-prefill cache pressure and high eviction rate.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2443 - kv-cache pressure -> streaming stalls. Pager notified: @kevin
kevin: I'm on it, pulling logs and checking the prefill vs decode worker ratios.
oliver: p95 jumped from 90ms -> 780ms. p99 at ~3.2s for streaming tokens. Errors are mostly 524/timeout stalls in streaming layer.
sana: customer impact: we've got elevated streaming stalls for ~2.1% of requests in prod-us-west for models with long context. Some customers report truncated streams.
maria: good to know. Is this correlated with recent rollout? deploy-bot: Can confirm there was a small prefill scheduler change 02:45Z (PR 3784) that adjusted prefill_batch_timeout from 8ms -> 20ms.
kevin: grabbing pod metrics: prefill-reactor pods show memory spikes and accelerated LRU evictions; decode pods underutilized.
oliver: sounds like prefill is thrashing KV groups; fragmentation visible: many small KV keys created due to variable prefix lengths.
kevin: mitigation plan: 1) scale prefill pods +2 temporarily 2) bump prefill_eviction_delay to 600s 3) add temporary route to fallback model-compact variant for latency-sensitive customers
sana: can we do a quick knob flip instead of scaling? scaling will help but might take minutes.
maria: try bumping eviction_delay first, also set prefill_max_entries per shard to prevent runaway fragmentation.
kevin: running command: ```kubectl -n prod patch deployment prefill-reactor --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/1/value","value":"600"}]'``` - applying
deploy-bot: patch applied to prefill-reactor (replicas unchanged)
oliver: watching metrics... eviction rate halved within 40s, p95 improving to ~220ms, p99 down to ~1.1s, streaming stalls reducing.
maria: still seeing KV fragmentation though; long-term we need compaction job to merge adjacent small entries.
kevin: starting scale now: `kubectl scale deployment prefill-reactor --replicas=8 -n prod` to catch up with backlog
sana: handoff note: I need to jump to a customer call at 03:12Z. If things re-escalate, @kevin takes incident.
maria: oncall handoff: kevin +100. kevin, if we cannot stabilize in 20m, escalate to eng-runtime and consider traffic shaping (route 5% traffic to hosted-cold variant).
kevin: acknowledged. creating a short-lived canary policy: route heavy-context requests to model-compact for 5% via router config.
oliver: can we also enable prefix-kv-cache bypass for messages > 1024 tokens? quick toggle in router config.
kevin: toggled bypass for >1024 tokens. watching.
maria: impact summary for postmortem: root cause likely prefill scheduler change increased prefill write patterns causing fragmentation and evictions; decode capacity mismatch amplified tail latency. Immediate mitigations: eviction delay bump, scale prefill, route heavy contexts to compact model, enable bypass for very long contexts.
sana: customer comms draft: \"We observed streaming stalls impacting a subset of long-context requests. Mitigations applied have reduced impact; further hardening in progress. Will follow up with postmortem.\" @kevin please review.
kevin: will review and update. last check: p95 ~150ms, p99 ~480ms, stalls down to 0.3%. leaving monitoring alerts at elevated thresholds until tomorrow 09:00Z.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2443 updated: mitigations applied, severity reduced to P2.
maria: thanks team. kevin, keep ownership until stabilization confirmed or morning handoff. I'll open postmortem template and include logs + commands used.
kevin: taking owner. logging notes to incident doc and will attach grafana snapshots.
maria: :thumbsup:
